'''Steven Lewis Cheap, Winning, Echo Base Operations Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Steven Lewis]]
* '''Published:''' July 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Cheap, Winning, Echo Base Operations Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Cheap, Winning, Echo Base Operation.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

This is an inexpensive, tournament winning deck that utilizes strategies from ALL expansions to date! This is the ideal deck for players who have the skill but not necessarily the cash!

== Strategy ==

Step 1: Get a droid (preferably "Artoo") on the War Room and start using "How Did We Get Into This Mess" to cycle through your deck and pull up your locations.

Step 2: Get one character on three different Echo sites (preferably "Figrin", "Leesub", and "Wedge") and play "Echo Base Operations". Also at this point, begin using the "Never Tell Me The Odds" cards.

Step 3: Get out your starships and squadrons and begin draining in space. Don't forget to be sure and occupy Clak'dor VII so "Figrin" will be destiny +2 when "Never Tell Me The Odds" comes up.

Use "Arcona" and/or the "Tauntaun" if opponent tries to drain on "Hoth". Use the "Figrin"/"Artoo" combo to retrieve Force and assist in cycling through your deck and use "Leesub" when possible to take out your opponent's hand. Your Force Drains will be in the double-digits and the game should end rather quickly once "Echo Base Operations" comes into play.

Note: Commons and Uncommons can be substituted for many of the Rares to make this design even CHEAPER! Some examples include more "Toryn Farrs" instead of "Wedges", more "R5M2's" instead of "Artoos", another "Corvette" in place of the "Tantive IV", some miscellaneous Bith characters in place of the "Leesubs", and finally some "Y-wings" and Y-wing squadrons in place of the "X-wings" and X-wing squadrons! The only NECESSARY Rares are the "Echo Base Operations" and "Clak'dor VII"! What more could you ask for?
